titulo: Next to him, it became a plan
caption:
Next to him, it became a plan

Across the table it was a negotiation. Next to him it became a plan.

Sitting on the same side points you both at the problem instead of at each other.

For whoever moves to your side of the table.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table and a clipboard with a page standing in the middle. A royal blue block figure on the right looks down with narrowed eyes. A ink-black block figure with white eyes on the left says let's look together. in a bubble, walks around to the blue one's side and the page slides over between them. The blue one looks up with wide eyes and a bubble says okay, show me. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me moving to their side of the table.
